snippet.title: GORE | Gameplay Trailer 2 (Found Footage Indie Horror Game)
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW!:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3943880/GORE/
-
X: https://x.com/cosmicarcadepro
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/cosmicarcadegames/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@cosmicarcadegames
itch.io: https://cosmic-arcade.itch.io/
-
GORE is a found footage horror experience that immerses players in a mountain range designed to resemble the scenery of the Pacific Northwest of the United States. Drawing inspiration from the likes of Lovecraft, 2001: A Space Odyssey, and John Carpenter’s The Thing, this game pulls you deep into a decaying wilderness where something incomprehensible is rapidly spreading through the surrounding environment. You must discover where this fleshy entity came from, armed with only a flashlight and handheld camera. 

Releasing Oct. 31st and will also be available on itch.io! 
-
Horror music by M-Murray on freesound.org - - Beep SFX in trailer created by me.
-
#foundfootage #analoghorror #vhshorror #indiegame #foryou #gore
